```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(afex)
library(car)
library(DescTools)
library(rstatix)
```

# Reading in the Data
``` {r reading in all files}
all_files <- list.files(
  "Image Data/",
  pattern = "Results_.*\\.csv$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

all_data <- tibble(file = all_files) %>%
  mutate(
    filename = basename(file),
    expt_folder = basename(dirname(file)),
    treatment = str_extract(expt_folder, "M9|TCAA"),
    experiment = str_extract(expt_folder, "(?<=Expt )\\d+"),
    image_number = str_extract(filename, "\\d+") %>% as.numeric(),
    data = map(file, read_csv)
  ) %>%
  unnest(data)
```

``` {r M9 Data}
all_m9_data <- all_data %>%
  filter(treatment == "M9") %>%
  mutate(ph = case_when(image_number %in% c("1905", "1985", "2037") ~ 7.1,
                        image_number %in% c("1906", "1986", "2038") ~ 7,
                        image_number %in% c("1907", "1987", "2039") ~ 6.5,
                        image_number %in% c("1910", "1988", "2040") ~ 6,
                        image_number %in% c("1909", "1989", "2041") ~ 5.5,
                        image_number %in% c("1908", "1990", "2044") ~ 5.35
                        )) %>%
  mutate(worm_number = `...1`) %>%
  mutate(ph = factor(ph)) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  dplyr::select(treatment, ph, experiment, worm_number, length)
```

``` {r TCAA Expt}
all_tcaa_data <- all_data %>%
  filter(treatment == "TCAA") %>%
  mutate(dose = case_when(image_number %in% c("1924", "2045", "2005") ~ "86 mM",
                        image_number %in% c("1925", "2046", "2006") ~ "50 mM",
                        image_number %in% c("1926", "2047", "2001") ~ "30 mM",
                        image_number %in% c("1929", "2048", "2002") ~ "10 mM",
                        image_number %in% c("1928", "2049", "2009") ~ "5 mM",
                        image_number %in% c("1927", "2050", "2010") ~ "3 mM",
                        image_number %in% c("1936", "2051", "2012") ~ "1 mM",
                        image_number %in% c("1937", "2052", "2013") ~ "500 uM",
                        image_number %in% c("1938", "2053", "2014") ~ "300 uM",
                        image_number %in% c("1941", "2054", "2015") ~ "100 uM",
                        image_number %in% c("1940", "2055", "2016") ~ "50 uM",
                        image_number %in% c("1939", "2056", "2017") ~ "M9"
                        )) %>%
  mutate(worm_number = `...1`) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  dplyr::select(treatment, dose, experiment, worm_number, length) %>%
  mutate(dose = factor(dose,
    levels = c("M9", "50 uM", "100 uM", "300 uM", "500 uM", "1 mM", "3 mM", "5 mM", "10 mM", "30 mM", "50 mM", "86 mM"),
    labels = c("M9", "50 µM", "100 µM", "300 µM", "500 µM", "1 mM", "3 mM", "5 mM", "10 mM", "30 mM", "50 mM", "86 mM")
  ))


```

# Initial Visualization
``` {r initial viz - M9 expt}
ggplot(all_m9_data, aes(x = factor(ph), y = length)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "col", fill = "skyblue", color = "black", width = 0.7) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.2, color = "black") +
  xlab("pH") +
  ylab("Mean Length") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),   # remove major gridlines
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),   # remove minor gridlines
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1)
  )
```

``` {r intial viz - TCAA expt}
ggplot(all_tcaa_data, aes(x = factor(dose), y = length)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "col", fill = "skyblue", color = "black", width = 0.7) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.2, color = "black") +
  xlab("Dose") +
  ylab("Mean Length") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),   # remove major gridlines
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),   # remove minor gridlines
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1)
  )
```

# ANOVA
``` {r running the Anova - M9}

model <- aov(length ~ ph, data = all_m9_data)
summary(model)

TukeyHSD(model)

#The raw data residuals are slightly non-normal so I may just correct using the M9 dose
res <- residuals(model)
qqnorm(res)
qqline(res)
```

``` {r running the Anova - TCAA}
model_tcaa <- aov(length ~ dose, data = all_tcaa_data)
summary(model_tcaa)

TukeyHSD(model_tcaa)

#The raw data residuals are non-normal so I will normalize for sure.
res <- residuals(model_tcaa)
qqnorm(res)
qqline(res)
```

# Normalization of the Data
``` {r normalizing to the normal M9 dose - M9}
all_m9_data_outlier_filtered <- all_m9_data %>%
  group_by(ph, experiment) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_length = mean(length),
    sd_length   = sd(length),
    is_outlier  = abs(length - mean_length) > 2 * sd_length   # ±2 SD
  ) %>%
  filter(!is_outlier) %>%
  dplyr::select(-mean_length, -sd_length, -is_outlier) %>%
  ungroup()

n_total_m9 <- nrow(all_m9_data)
n_removed_m9 <- n_total_m9 - nrow(all_m9_data_outlier_filtered)

all_m9_data_norm <- all_m9_data_outlier_filtered %>%
  group_by(experiment) %>%
  mutate(control_mean = mean(length[ph == 7.1]),
         percent_control = length / control_mean * 100) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-control_mean)
```

``` {r normalizing to the normal M9 dose - TCAA}
all_tcaa_data_outlier_filtered <- all_tcaa_data %>%
  group_by(dose, experiment) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_length = mean(length),
    sd_length   = sd(length),
    is_outlier  = abs(length - mean_length) > 2 * sd_length   # ±2 SD
  ) %>%
  filter(!is_outlier) %>%
  dplyr::select(-mean_length, -sd_length, -is_outlier) %>%
  ungroup()

n_total_tcaa <- nrow(all_tcaa_data)
n_removed_tcaa <- n_total_tcaa - nrow(all_tcaa_data_outlier_filtered)

all_tcaa_data_norm <- all_tcaa_data_outlier_filtered %>%
  group_by(experiment) %>%
  mutate(control_mean = mean(length[dose == "M9"]),
         percent_control = length / control_mean * 100) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-control_mean)
```

# ANOVA Using Normalized Data
``` {r running the ANOVA - M9}
model_2 <- aov(percent_control ~ ph, data = all_m9_data_norm)
summary(model_2)

res <- residuals(model_2)
qqnorm(res)
qqline(res)

all_m9_data_norm %>%
  group_by(ph) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_length = mean(percent_control),
    sd_length = sd(percent_control),
    var_length = var(percent_control)
  )
#Variances are mostly fine but I will use Welch's anyway

leveneTest(percent_control ~ factor(ph), data = all_m9_data_norm)

welch_model <- oneway.test(percent_control ~ ph,
                           data = all_m9_data_norm,
                           var.equal = FALSE)  # FALSE = Welch
welch_model

all_m9_data_norm$ph <- relevel(factor(all_m9_data_norm$ph), ref = "7.1")

#Games-Howell
games_howell_ph <- all_m9_data_norm %>%
  games_howell_test(percent_control ~ ph) %>%
  filter(group1 == "7.1" | group2 == "7.1") %>%
  mutate(
    estimate = round(estimate, 3),
    conf.low = round(conf.low, 3),
    conf.high = round(conf.high, 3),
    p.adj = case_when(
      p.adj < 0.001 ~ "< 0.001",
      TRUE ~ as.character(round(p.adj, 4))
    )
  ) %>%
  select(group1, group2, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.adj)

games_howell_ph
```

``` {r running the ANOVA - TCAA}
model_tcaa_2 <- aov(percent_control ~ dose, data = all_tcaa_data_norm)
summary(model_tcaa_2)

res <- residuals(model_tcaa_2)
qqnorm(res)
qqline(res)

all_tcaa_data_norm %>%
  group_by(dose) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_length = mean(percent_control),
    sd_length = sd(percent_control),
    var_length = var(percent_control)
  )
#Variances are definitely not homogenous, qqplot is a bit better. Definitely will use the robust ANOVA.

leveneTest(percent_control ~ factor(dose), data = all_tcaa_data_norm)

welch_model_tcaa <- oneway.test(percent_control ~ dose,
                           data = all_tcaa_data_norm,
                           var.equal = FALSE)  # FALSE = Welch
welch_model_tcaa


# Games-Howell
games_howell_tcaa <- all_tcaa_data_norm %>%
  games_howell_test(percent_control ~ dose) %>%
  filter(group1 == "M9" | group2 == "M9") %>%
  mutate(
    estimate = round(estimate, 3),
    conf.low = round(conf.low, 3),
    conf.high = round(conf.high, 3),
    p.adj = case_when(
      p.adj < 0.001 ~ "< 0.001",
      TRUE ~ as.character(round(p.adj, 4))
    )
  ) %>%
  select(group1, group2, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.adj)

games_howell_tcaa
```

# Visualizing the Normalized Data
``` {r normalized viz - M9 Expt}
cld_df <- data.frame(
  ph = factor(c("7.1", "5.35", "5.5", "6", "6.5", "7"),
              levels = levels(all_m9_data_norm$ph)),
  letter = c("a", "a", "a", "a", "b", "a")
)

m9_summary <- all_m9_data_norm %>%
  group_by(ph) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(percent_control),
    se = sd(percent_control) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(cld_df, by = "ph") %>%
  mutate(label_y = mean + se + 5)  # adjust the + 3 for more/less padding


ggplot(all_m9_data_norm, aes(x = factor(ph), y = percent_control)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "col", fill = "steelblue", color = "black", width = 0.4) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.15, color = "black", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_text(data = m9_summary %>%
            mutate(stars = case_when(
              ph == "6.5" ~ "***",
              TRUE ~ ""
            )),
          aes(x = ph, y = label_y, label = stars),
          size = 4, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Percent Control of C. elegans Body Size by pH",
    x = "pH",
    y = "Percent Control of Length"
  ) +
scale_x_discrete(
  expand = expansion(add = 0.8),
  labels = c("7.1" = "7.1 (M9)", "5.35" = "5.35", "5.5" = "5.5", "6" = "6", "6.5" = "6.5", "7" = "7")
) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 125),
    breaks = seq(0, 125, by = 25),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")
  )

ggsave("celegans_body_size_pH.jpeg", dpi = 300, width = 6, height = 5, units = "in")
```

``` {r normalized viz - TCAA Expt}
cld_df <- data.frame(
  dose = factor(c("M9", "50 µM", "100 µM", "300 µM", "500 µM", "1 mM", "3 mM", "5 mM", "10 mM", "30 mM", "50 mM", "86 mM"),
                levels = levels(all_tcaa_data_norm$dose)),
  letter = c("ab", "ab", "ab", "b", "b", "ab", "a", "c", "d", "d", "d", "d")  
)

tcaa_summary <- all_tcaa_data_norm %>%
  group_by(dose) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(percent_control),
    se = sd(percent_control) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(cld_df, by = "dose") %>%
  mutate(label_y = mean + se + 5)  # adjust the + 3 for more/less padding


ggplot(all_tcaa_data_norm, aes(x = factor(dose), y = percent_control)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "col", fill = "steelblue", color = "black", width = 0.4) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.15, color = "black", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_text(data = tcaa_summary %>% 
            mutate(stars = case_when(
              dose == "300 µM" ~ "*",
              dose == "500 µM" ~ "***",
              dose == "3 mM"   ~ "**",
              dose == "5 mM"   ~ "***",
              dose == "10 mM"  ~ "***",
              dose == "30 mM"  ~ "***",
              dose == "50 mM"  ~ "***",
              dose == "86 mM" ~ "***",
              TRUE ~ ""  # no stars for non-significant
            )),
          aes(x = dose, y = label_y, label = stars),
          size = 4, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Percent Control of C. elegans Body Size by TCA Dose",
    x = "TCA Dose",
    y = "Percent Control of Length"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete() +
  scale_y_continuous(
  limits = c(0, 125),
  breaks = seq(0, 125, by = 25),
  expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")
  )

ggsave("celegans_body_size_tcaa.jpeg", dpi = 300, width = 6, height = 5, units = "in")
```
